title: America's $40 Trillion Debt Explained Like You're 5
desc_head:
The U.S. is $40+ trillion in debt — and it's growing by the second. 🇺🇸💸Why does the U.S. have so much debt? How did we get here, and why does it actually matter to you? In this video, we break down the U.S. national debt in plain, simple terms — no confusing jargon, just clear stickman animation. What you'll learn:
📌 What the national debt actually is (and what it isn't)
📌 How the U.S. got to $40 trillion — wars, tax cuts, recessions, and more
📌 The difference between the national debt vs. the deficit
📌 Why the US debt crisis could affect your money, jobs, and the economy
📌 Why economists worr

Too much debt and no one want to lend to you any more: Last week's 20y bond auction flopped with a yield of 5.42%. Jan-July 2026 US sold $18.9Tn treasuries ($2.7Tn/ month).
